_doc: Readers that real-data-replay.py runs once at the base ref and once at HEAD over the same real brain, then diffs. argv placeholders: {core} = the core checkout of that side, {brain} = a fresh copy of the brain for that run. A leading python3/python is replaced by the running interpreter (OS-17). normalise: regexes removed from every output line before the diff (volatile parts only - never a classification).

readers.name: open-items
readers.why: the session start's list of open items, split by who moves; --owner "" skips the PR search (network), so PR items are not part of this replay

readers.name: ledger-reconcile
readers.why: ledger checkboxes against their read-only checks; writes only its state file inside the brain copy
normalise: not reached within the \d+(\.\d+)? s budget.*$
